method.source: Complete shipped pinned descriptions hash-checked; explicitly listed subset fully re-read this pass. Native asset key/geometry audit uses installed Patreon plus official Free inventory. Mesh no-document-write behavior is covered by runtime regressions, not inferred from pure-pose sampling.

reread.name: Aquatic Pirouette
reread.reason: One 5-foot underwater evasion; sample lateral route, not a Fly or damaging spin.

reread.name: Arcane Propulsion
reread.reason: Grants a movement mode or changes its restriction; no Fly/Stride action occurs now. Keep a finite stationary manifestation.

reread.name: Artist's Attendance
reread.reason: Two Strides toward a runebearer. Rune tracing is optional and retains the native local rune cue.

reread.name: Ash Strider
reread.reason: Ash transit along a sample route; first-victim fire and real route remain player-selected. Concealment cue is finite, not a guaranteed condition.

reread.name: Bashing Charge
reread.reason: Two Strides toward an obstacle; no automatic Force Open success or damaging weapon Strike.

reread.name: Benefactor's Wings
reread.reason: Description explicitly uses Fly now. Short wing-assisted sample transit; actual height, endpoint and falling remain manual.

reread.name: Burning Jet
reread.reason: Base impulse is a straight flame-powered Stride. Higher-level Leap/hover is optional, not the default.

reread.name: Call to Battle
reread.reason: Stand, hang, hover or vertical-only movement has no lateral route. Retain a finite local pose rather than invent traversal.

reread.name: Catfolk Dance
reread.reason: Distracting/evasive gesture or Escape check does not itself grant unconditional traversal. Any later Step remains conditional.

reread.name: Clang!
reread.reason: Default shows Stride toward the attacker; the alternative Strike is not emitted in addition.

reread.name: Clever Gambit
reread.reason: Post-trigger Step or Stride; sample short reposition only, not another Strike.

reread.name: Cratering Drop
reread.reason: Source and selected already-falling target descend together. Actual height, ground contact and falling damage remain native outcomes.

reread.name: Cushion Landing
reread.reason: Choose the actual mount as animation source. Mount transit is sampled; the rider's fall/pickup and real Mount operation remain manual.

reread.name: Cycle of Souls
reread.reason: One Step then a chosen animist stance; stance selection stays manual.

reread.name: Cyclonic Ascent
reread.reason: Grants a movement mode or changes its restriction; no Fly/Stride action occurs now. Keep a finite stationary manifestation.

reread.name: Dangle (Vanara)
reread.reason: Stand, hang, hover or vertical-only movement has no lateral route. Retain a finite local pose rather than invent traversal.

reread.name: Danse Macabre
reread.reason: Choose the horde as source. Its transit is sampled; once-per-victim Mobbing Assault and conditional dragging require selected actual victims.

reread.name: Daring Act
reread.reason: Shows the successful check's half-Speed departure; critical full-Speed choice stays manual.

reread.name: Dashing Pickup
reread.reason: Choose the actual mount as animation source. Mount transit is sampled; the rider's fall/pickup and real Mount operation remain manual.

reread.name: Defensive Instincts
reread.reason: One short Step after the trigger; no invented long charge.

reread.name: Determined Dash
reread.reason: Base activity is two Strides; third-Stride option, terrain and checks remain PF2e.

reread.name: Disengaging Twist

reread.name: Dive of the Divine
